title: not as ... as
summary: Конструкция **not as ... as** («не такой … как») и выражение **the same as**.
ru:
## not as ... as
Эта конструкция говорит, что кто-то или что-то **менее** … , чем другой. Прилагательное стоит в обычной форме (без -er и без more).
> Rome is **not as old as** Athens. — Рим не такой старый, как Афины. (= Афины старше.)
> The Grand Hotel **isn't as expensive as** the Europa. — Гранд-отель не такой дорогой, как Европа.
> I don't play tennis **as often as** you. — Я играю в теннис не так часто, как ты.

## not as much as / not as many as
С количеством используем **as much** (с неисчисляемыми) и **as many** (с исчисляемыми во множественном числе).
> I haven't got **as much money as** you. — У меня не так много денег, как у тебя.
> I don't know **as many people as** you. — Я знаю не так много людей, как ты.

## Сравните: not as ... as и than
Одну и ту же мысль можно сказать двумя способами.
> Rome is **not as old as** Athens. = Athens is **older than** Rome.
> Tennis **isn't as popular as** football. = Football is **more popular than** tennis.

## as me / as him
После **as** в разговоре обычно **me / him / her / us / them**.
> She's not as old as **him**. = ... as **he is**.
> You don't work as hard as **me**. = ... as **I do**.

## the same as
Когда два предмета одинаковые, говорим **the same as**.
> The weather today is **the same as** yesterday. — Сегодня такая же погода, как вчера.
> My hair is **the same colour as** yours. — У меня такой же цвет волос, как у тебя.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~not so old than~~ → not **as** old **as**
- ~~Rome isn't older as Athens~~ → Rome isn't **as old as** Athens
- ~~the same like~~ → the same **as**
- ~~not as more expensive as~~ → not **as expensive as**
en:
## not as ... as
We use **not as ... as** to say that something is **less** than another thing. The adjective stays in its basic form (no -er, no more).
> Rome is **not as old as** Athens. (= Athens is older.)
> The Grand Hotel **isn't as expensive as** the Europa.
> I don't play tennis **as often as** you.

## not as much as / not as many as
> I haven't got **as much money as** you.
> I don't know **as many people as** you.
We use **much** with uncountable nouns and **many** with plural nouns.

## Compare: not as ... as and than
You can say the same thing in two ways.
> Rome is **not as old as** Athens. = Athens is **older than** Rome.
> Tennis **isn't as popular as** football. = Football is **more popular than** tennis.

## as me / as him
After **as** we usually say **me / him / her / us / them**.
> She's not as old as **him**. = ... as **he is**.
> You don't work as hard as **me**. = ... as **I do**.

## the same as
> The weather today is **the same as** yesterday.
> My hair is **the same colour as** yours.

## Common mistakes
- ~~not so old than~~ → not **as** old **as**
- ~~the same like~~ → the same **as**
structure:
## Формула
> Подлежащее + **isn't / aren't / don't** + **as** + прилагательное / наречие + **as** + второй предмет
> This coat **isn't as warm as** that one. · He **doesn't run as fast as** me.

## С количеством
| Существительное | Конструкция |
|---|---|
| неисчисляемое (money, time) | not **as much** money **as** |
| исчисляемое мн. ч. (people, books) | not **as many** books **as** |

## Два способа сказать одно и то же
| not as ... as | comparative + than |
|---|---|
| My bag **isn't as heavy as** yours. | Yours **is heavier than** mine. |
| I **don't earn as much as** you. | You **earn more than** me. |

## the same
> the same **as** + кто/что
> the same **colour / size / age / time** + as
> We have **the same** teacher. · He's **the same age as** me.

exercises.title: Дополните предложения
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужные слова, чтобы значение осталось тем же.
exercises.example: Athens is older than Rome. = Rome isn't **as** old **as** Athens.

items.text: My room is bigger than yours. = Your room isn't {{as}} big {{as}} mine.
Tom is taller than Max. = Max isn't {{as}} tall {{as}} Tom.
A train is faster than a bus. = A bus isn't {{as}} fast {{as}} a train.
You got up earlier than me. = I didn't get up {{as}} early {{as}} you.
My brother has more books than me. = I haven't got {{as many}} books {{as}} my brother.
She drinks more coffee than him. = He doesn't drink {{as much}} coffee {{as}} her.
The cinema isn't as expensive {{as}} the theatre.
This book is more interesting {{than}} that one.
I don't work as hard {{as}} you.

items.q: I haven't got ___ time as you.
There aren't ___ chairs as last time.
My coat is the same colour ___ yours.

items.why: В разговоре: as **him** (или as he is).

items.q: Football is more popular than tennis. = Tennis isn't ___ football.
items.why: Второй способ сказать то же: **not as popular as**.

items.q: Как сказать «Он не такой высокий, как его отец»?
options: He isn't as tall as his father.
He isn't as taller as his father.
He isn't so tall than his father.

items.q: Как сказать «У меня такая же машина, как у тебя»?
options: I have the same car like you.
I have the same car as you.
I have the same car than you.

items.q: Как сказать «Я готовлю не так хорошо, как ты»?
options: I don't cook as well as you.
I don't cook as better as you.
I don't cook more well than you.
items.why: Наречие well остаётся в обычной форме: as **well** as.

items.q: Как сказать «Здесь не так много людей, как вчера»?
options: There aren't as many people as yesterday.
There aren't as much people as yesterday.
There aren't as many peoples as yesterday.
